system.effect: Burmy quickly builds a cloak out of nearby materials; using leaves and twigs will give it a @UUID[Compendium.ptu.effects.Item.r7ObsmQqpSsvNpBQ]{Grass Plant Cloak}, using sand and rocks will give it a @UUID[Compendium.ptu.effects.Item.759SE77gMLIDVChl]{Ground Sandy Cloak}, and using trash or scrap will give it a @UUID[Compendium.ptu.effects.Item.SObcZDxFAAnnkJZs]{Steel Trash Cloak}. While in a Cloak, Burmy gains the Type associated with the Cloak as a secondary Typing, which will become permanent upon evolution into Wormadam. Cloaks are destroyed if Burmy is hit for Super-Effective Damage, or if Burmy makes a new Cloak. Innate.
